title: Read a query string
summary: Fastify: Read a query string. Visit /search with no q.
introduction: Query input follows the question mark. GET /search?q=cat reads q.
learningObjectives: Read a query string with Fastify

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install fastify@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000 and stop each server before the next example.

blocks.title: Read a query string

blocks.text: request.query.q holds cat. The type check accepts it and creates the term field.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Check query values rather than assuming they are always strings.
